items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: So I say, let's take Peggy, this girl (inaudible). ... We took this girl.

ctx.x: He was (inaudible) and we -- we're supposed to go up to the -- to play the college stage. We have three days at Yale University. In those days they used to feature, they used to bring to those campuses all the big jazz bands playing (inaudible) at universities (inaudible) began in this manner.

So I say, let's take Peggy, this girl (inaudible). He say, man -- I say, we take her to the beauty parlor. I'll take her to the beauty parlor. We'll get a nice evening gown. Let me worry about her. So he say all right. Go on.
We took this girl. We didn't have no music for her.
